data.long_meaning: The name 'Sreeja' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sri', which means 'wealth'. The prefix 'ja' denotes 'born'. Thus, the name 'Sreeja' signifies 'Goddess of Wealth, born'. This name is associated with prosperity, abundance, and good fortune in Hindu tradition. The name Sreeja carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sreeja usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Sreeja belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sreeja total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
